scripts.build: vp run build:plugin && vp run --filter @open-emdash/web build
scripts.build:cloudflare: vp run build:plugin && vp run --filter @open-emdash/web build:cloudflare
scripts.check: vp run build:plugin && vp run --filter @open-emdash/site-builder --filter @open-emdash/web check
scripts.test: vp run build:plugin && vp run --filter @open-emdash/site-builder --filter @open-emdash/web test
scripts.verify: vp run check && vp run test && vp run build
